description: Median House Sales by Quarter, SA is a report listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by SA Valuer-General. Data collated by the SA Valuer General showing the median house sale price by quarter for Adelaide and other towns in South Australia. The data is also available via a graph showing change over time. The data is grouped into metropolitan Adelaide (similar to GCCSA) and non-metro major towns in South Australia. Users can then link to further disaggregation of metropolitan Adelaide by suburb. Coverage is the states and territories, 2011 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as quarterly, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-10-27. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
